# Experience Report (ICSE SEET 2027)

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| **Page limit** | Max **10 pages**, plus up to **2 pages of references** (strict; violations are desk-rejected) |
| **Definition** | Anecdotal evidence describing an experience in SE education and training (typically a course, a teaching/training technique or strategy, or an assessment method), interpreted in terms of actionable advice and lessons learned. Does **not** require rigorous evaluation or research methods. **Negative and mixed findings are acceptable** provided they support advice or lessons learned. |
| **Evaluation criteria** | Relevance, Significance, Actionability, Lessons, Presentation (see [criterion definitions](../../evaluation-criteria)) |
